name: Image Pilot – Image Compression and Optimization for WordPress
author: prasadkirpekar

sections.description:
Image Pilot helps you compress and optimize images in WordPress to improve loading speed, reduce bandwidth, and save disk space without visible quality loss.

Whether you run a blog, portfolio, or eCommerce site, Image Pilot makes image optimization simple:
* Compress JPG, PNG, GIF, and WEBP images from the plugin dashboard
* Keep image quality high while reducing file size
* Resize images to match your site layout
* Regenerate thumbnails after theme or size changes
* Improve Core Web Vitals and overall page performance

Image Pilot is easy to set up and provides manual, admin-triggered optimization for Media Library and upload directory images.

Image Pilot offers:

  • High-quality image compression without any loss in quality
  • Easy resizing of images to suit your website’s needs
  • Thumbnail regeneration to optimize all your images
  • Simple installation and user-friendly controls
  • Upgrade your website’s image optimization with our powerful WordPress plugin today!
